entry.title: CVE-2026-115731 (Perforce Puppet Enterprise): CISA's federal patch deadline is 2026-12-01
entry.summary: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability. Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Not an endorsement by CISA.

entry.title: CVE-2026-123039 (Check Point Multiple Products): CISA's federal patch deadline is 2026-11-16
entry.summary: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability. Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). entry.summary: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability. entry.summary: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. entry.summary: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed.
